name: MedXpertQA Text v3
protocol: MedXpertQA v3 Text full 2,450-question test split, official zero-shot CoT and answer cleansing, no retrieval or tools. Seeded 10% sample results and the multimodal track are excluded.

explanation.en: Accuracy is the fraction of the complete 2,450-question Text test set whose extracted option matches the gold label.
explanation.zh: Accuracy 是完整 2,450 道 Text test question 中，模型提取选项与标准答案一致的比例。

summary.en: MedXpertQA Text tests expert medical knowledge and clinical reasoning with difficult ten-option questions across specialized practice.
summary.zh: MedXpertQA Text 通过高难度十选一医学题，测试模型在多个专科中的医学知识和临床推理能力。

task_format.en: The model answers one of ten options for each text-only medical question under the official zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt, without retrieval or tools.
task_format.zh: 模型按照官方 zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt 回答 text-only 医学十选一题，不使用 retrieval 或 tool。
